text:
maria: Heads-up — we're opening a limited preview for A800-Lite dedicated micro-pools in eu-north (Stockholm) and ca-west (Vancouver). Targets: low-latency inference for edge-adjacent workloads. Starting tomorrow 05:00 UTC we'll accept reservations for committed slices through the Console and API. :rocket:
kevin: Are these preemptible or sustained? pricing tier?
maria: These are sustained-reserve pools (non-preemptible) with a small burst buffer. SLA: 99.9% availability for reserved capacity. Burst policy: up to 15% of pool can be used as short-lived burst for 2m windows, 3x/day.
liz: Docs + reservation flow: https://internal.redwood.io/dedicated/a800-lite (internal). Use Console > Dedicated > Regions > eu-north / ca-west. API snippet below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/dedicated/reservations \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n -d '{"region":"eu-north","gpu_type":"a800-lite","units":4,"term_months":12}'
```
sanjay: any guidance on model quantization/packing? want perf numbers before committing.
maria: Recommend int8 qpack for best cost/perf. Perf benchmarks: avg 60ms p50 for 8k context with 4 units; see perf sheet (linked in doc).
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> GA. Canary starts 2026-04-02 05:00 UTC. Notifying capacity controllers.
ops-bot: initial fleet sizes: eu-north = 32 units (8 clusters), ca-west = 24 units (6 clusters). Burst buffer accounted.
kevin: Migration notes for existing A800 reservations?
maria: If you have existing a800-full reservations, contact SRE for a conversion offer. We'll provide prorated credit + 60d overlap window. Use conversion form: https://intra.redwood.io/dedicated/convert
andrew: Thx — will loop in partners CS. Any special billing flags for this preview?
finance: Preview billing uses test-rate SKU a800-lite.preview (no immediate charge; billed on conversion). We'll only apply charges on conversion or GA opt-in.
liz: FYI quota window: you may request expansion via Console quota page; expect 24-48h turnaround for preview requests.
maria: Questions? I'll host a 30m office hours tomorrow 10:00 CET in #eng to walk through reservation flows. :calendar:
